name: The Butler Twins
description: '''The Butler Twins''' were an [[United States|American]] [[Detroit blues]] and [[electric blues|electric]] [[blues]] [[duet (music)|duo]] of the [[twin]] brothers '''Clarence''' (January 21, 1942 – December 22, 2003) and '''Curtis Butler''' (January 21, 1942 – April 9, 2004). Longtime semiprofessional performers in the local blues scene in [[Detroit]], they gained international recognition following the [[sound recording and reproduction|recording]] of three albums in the late 1990s. Their best-known track was "The Butler's Boogie".
